subject: Post-demo: consumption projection, budget band, and trial credit request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Simon Brooks <simon.brooks@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmeretail.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + consumption projection & credit ask

Hi Simon / Priya,

Great to meet earlier — appreciate the walk-through of Acme's search personalization use case. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align the pilot.

Summary from our side:
- Target workload: session-based reranking + short-form generation for product descriptions; typical prompt length ~120 tokens, responses ~60 tokens.
- Expected Q1 pilot traffic: ~3k sessions/day, ~4 completions/session => ~1.8M tokens/day (peak smoothing assumed).
- Target economics: engineering wants a starter target of ~$85 / 1M tokens to evaluate unit economics in-app (your CFO asked for a target band).

Suggested pilot plan:
1) 2-week ramp (smoke → 50% traffic) then 4-week production pilot at target SLA.
2) Redwood provides a $15k trial credit and a one-time pilot extension (if we see high initial consumption, we can extend credits by an equivalent amount subject to intake).
3) Instrumentation: we'll provide a dashboard for token-level cost and per-route latency breakdowns.

Requests from you to proceed:
- Confirm the ballpark token projection above (so I can finalize the cost estimate).
- Confirm internal budget band for the pilot (range is fine).
- Any procurement/compliance docs we should loop in early?

Attached: pilot_scope.xlsx (ramp & success criteria), 1m_token_unit_econ.pdf (sample unit economics at different rates).

Next steps: If you confirm the projection + budget range today, I’ll request credits and draft the mutual action plan.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Simon Brooks <simon.brooks@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmeretail.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + consumption projection & credit ask

Thanks Marissa — good summary and captures the call. A couple of clarifications: 

- The 1.8M tokens/day is in line with our rough estimate, though we expect a lower steady-state after warm-up (~1.2M/day). Peak could hit 2M/day during promos.
- Budget: we have an initial pilot budget of $50–75k for vendor spend (not including internal SRE costs). We'd like to see whether that maps to 4–6 weeks of pilot at your proposed economics.
- Procurement: Priya is our procurement lead; she’ll need your standard SOW + SOC2 report.

Can you confirm what $/1M token rates correspond to your $15k credit — i.e., how many tokens that covers at the per-1M rate you propose? Also, if we exceed the credit early, what’s the process for a one-time extension?

Simon
Director of Product — Search & Merchandising
Acme Retail
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Simon Brooks <simon.brooks@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmeretail.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + consumption projection & credit ask

Hi team — looping in with credit/ops confirmation.

Marissa: based on the projected average (1.2M steady → 2M peak), pricing scenarios we can offer for the pilot:
- Standard eval rate: $120 / 1M tokens (hosted, with priority routing)
- Discounted pilot rate (applies for pilot only, subject to commit): $85 / 1M tokens

The $15k trial credit at $85 / 1M covers ~176k * 85? Wait need clean math... Correction: $15,000 / $85 per 1M tokens = ~176k 1M-token-units? That phrasing is confusing; let's be explicit:
- At $85 per 1M tokens, $15,000 covers ~176,470,588 tokens (i.e., 176.47M tokens).
- If you run at 1.5M tokens/day average, that credit would cover ~117 days of traffic.

Extension process: if credits are exhausted before pilot end, your AE (Marissa) can request a one-time top-up (up to an additional $15k) subject to approval by commercial ops; approval window typically same business day. For larger extensions we require an exec sponsor approval and alignment on expected conversion metrics.

Operational notes:
- We’ll instrument per-route token meters and daily burn reports during the pilot.
- If you want guaranteed $/1M beyond pilot, we can prepare a reserved capacity quote (Dedicated) — separate process.

Marissa — I approved the $15k credit for Acme Retail and pre-authorized a one-time $15k top-up discretionary approval. Please attach the SOW + SOC2 link for procurement.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Simon Brooks <simon.brooks@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmeretail.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + consumption projection & credit ask

Perfect — thanks Rishi, and thanks Simon/Priya for the fast turnaround. 

Simon: I’ve attached the SOW template and SOC2 link here and created a short MAP that calls out the 6-week pilot with the $15k credit + one-time discretionary $15k top-up. If you’re comfortable with that, I’ll: 
1) Kick off the DocuSign for the SOW today.
2) Turn on the token meters and share a daily burn spreadsheet.
3) Schedule a 15-min check-in next Wednesday to review burn and adjust the ramp if needed.

Let me know and I’ll send the first set of documents.

—
Marissa
